reason: I don't look for events, they find me — a friend reposts a story and maybe I go. I'm not going to open a separate app after dinner when everything I stumble on is already in my Instagram feed.
objection: Even if the app shows me a yoga class or a hike, I'm not showing up alone to a group of strangers I found through an app; I go where my friends are going.
would_change_my_mind: If I could see that people I actually know are going — or if the events showed up in my Instagram stories so I stumble on them the way I always do — I'd try it for a concert ticket.
